title: Aaj hai madine me fatima ka gham barpa
body:
AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA
BAAP KE GUZARTE HI WO SITAM HUE TUJH PAR, ZALIMO NE DARWAZA BHI JALA DIYA AAKHIR, QAID KARKE WAALI KO GHAR SE LE GAYE KAFIR, HAYE KYA MUSIBAT THI DIL PA CHAL GAYE KHANJAR, AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA
EK QADAM NA CHALTI THI ZAEEK KI WO HALAT THI, PHIR BHI KAAM KARTI THI PEESTI THI CHAKKI BHI, BAAP KI MOHABBAT KO YAAD KARKE ROTI THI, HAYE TUJH KO UMMAT NE RONE NA DIYA BIBI, AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA
AUR BULA KE ZAINAB KO APNE PAAS BITHLAYI, BAZOO PAR LIYA BOSA AUR GALE SE LIPTAYI, KARBALA MEIN KYA HOGA RAAZ YE BHI BATLAYI, DUSHMANO KE NARGE MEIN HOGA PHIR TERA BHAYI, AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA
SAR KO PEET KAR ZAINAB KEHRAHI THI MAADAR SE, KIS PA CHOD KE HUMKO JA RAHI HO DUNIYA SE, BE SAHARA HOTE HAIN AMMA JAAN TERE BACCHE, KISKO HUM KAHEN AMMA YE TOH BOLIYE HUM SE, AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA
CHHAND DIN BABA KO RO SAKI NA JI BHAR KE, ZULM SEHKE UMMAT KE JO SIDHARI DUNIYA SE, MOOSAVI UDATE HAIN SAR PA KHAAK SHEHZAADE, MURTUZA KI AANKHON MEIN CHAGAYI HAI ANDHIYAREY, AAJ HAI MADINE MEIN FATIMA KA GHAM BARPA..
